name: Proposed P06 read-only Model receipt inspection
description: Unregistered proposal only. Implementation requires the separate activation gates in activation.json. Inspect existing local synthetic Model receipts within canonical Portal Health without changing backend APIs, identity or production gates.

userStories.title: Add the fixed Model receipt GET client and configured proxy
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want an explicit known request lookup so that I can inspect the existing backend-validated local model evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Change only canonical Portal src/api/model-receipt-client.ts, src/api/alert-client.ts, vite.config.ts and test/api-model-receipts.test.mjs after separately approved registration.

Use only GET /v1/local/model-receipts/:request_id with strict lowercase UUIDv4, the existing memory-only same-origin bearer session, omitted cookies, no-store, abort and existing configured runtime target. No arbitrary URLs or caller credentials.

Validate the existing exact ModelReceiptView, request_id equality, policy/model/task references, canonical nine-decimal probability strings, allowed null/unavailable forms and synthetic_shadow_only/training_eligible=false/enforcement=false markers. Do not invent a workspace_key absent from this DTO; bind request lifecycle to the verified session and enforce tenancy in backend fixture tests.
The envelope intentionally has no locale. Bypass localization-envelope validation only for this fixed GET. Preserve every existing transport and proxy route/profile.

Keep null receipt, unavailable model, ML_NOT_CONFIGURED, ML_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE, 401/403, invalid input, malformed response and network errors distinguishable; never substitute zero, safe or demo evidence.
Do not recompute receipt_sha256 from the redacted DTO or claim browser verification of the original snapshot/signature. Do not infer request_id equals assessment_run_id.
No backend API/schema, business write, model fitting/inference, dependency, login/logout, account rotation, production permission or source-account assumption is authorized by this proposal.
Quality gate in canonical Portal: ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --incremental false
Quality gate in canonical Portal: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/*.test.mjs
Quality gate in canonical Portal: ./node_modules/.bin/vite build

userStories.title: Integrate an explicit Model receipt inspection panel into Health
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want a read-only Health panel so that I can inspect a known receipt and its original references without changing business state.
acceptanceCriteria: Change only canonical Portal src/ModelReceiptPanel.tsx, src/locales/api-model-receipts.ts, src/api-model-receipts.css, src/ApiHealthPage.tsx, src/locales/api-health.ts, test/support/model-receipt-fixture.mjs and test/api-model-receipts-native.mjs.

Add a Model inspection tab using an explicit known request UUID; retain Detection/Operations/Risk/Sync behavior and existing session/permissions, tokens/fonts, EN/LO, shared disclosure, keyboard and reduced-motion behavior.

Display exact returned policy/task/model/version/artifact/dataset/feature/receipt references, probabilities and recorded actor/time. Keep raw probability strings and synthetic scope; do not average model probabilities and rule risk indices or imply production accuracy.

Offer Assessment and Alert links only from validated returned IDs, with no inferred hash parameter or fabricated reverse lookup. A request UUID may differ from its Assessment run UUID. No receipt inventory is inferred from a single lookup endpoint.

Treat receipt_sha256 as a stored reference; no browser-verification badge, fabricated external artifact bytes or historical current-cache linkage. Preserve null/unknown/unavailable meanings and all production/source/identity gates.

Hide obsolete evidence on request, tab, route, locale or session changes; abort old reads. Error/retry, refresh, null receipt, missing trust, denial and unavailable model remain explicit. Never fall back to fixture data in product code.

Introduce a real executable native browser smoke and owned disposable fixture; it must exercise an actual backend GET and validate UI behavior. No project business database writes, real source, model fitting, inference, new dependency or service adoption.

userStories.title: Accept native Model receipt reads and the complete browser state matrix
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want actual scoped API and browser proof so that unavailable or stale model evidence cannot be presented as a successful result.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend only canonical Portal test/api-model-receipts.test.mjs, test/api-model-receipts-native.mjs and test/support/model-receipt-fixture.mjs. Preserve all implementation and original test assertions.

Use actual NestJS, an owned disposable PostgreSQL fixture and existing synthetic signed model fixture patterns. Cover available and unavailable receipts, null/foreign request IDs, distinct request/run IDs, optional Alert references, missing trust, corrupt storage, outage/recovery and both required scopes.

Browser acceptance must exercise loading/empty/error/denied/unavailable/ready states, exact nine-decimal values and hashes, request and session races, stale read cancellation, refresh/retry and safe navigation. Capture actual requests and prove no business POST or fixture fallback occurred.
Verify EN/LO, keyboard navigation, shared disclosures, reduced motion and 320/375/414/768px layouts without overflow or runtime errors. Preserve other Health tabs and session renewal.

Do not claim a client-recomputed snapshot hash, model signature proof, model availability beyond the recorded receipt, calibrated real accuracy, verified accounts, population coverage or production readiness.

No persistent project writes, real source connection, model fitting/inference, account switching, downloads or new dependencies. Confirm cleanup of only owned processes/listeners/fixtures and retain bounded private receipts with current source hashes.

userStories.title: Close the local Model receipt readback with current-source checks and honest handoff
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a reproducible local handoff so that future work can distinguish accepted read-only support from unverified production targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Change only canonical Portal MODEL-RECEIPTS-API.md and an append to backend docs/implementation-status/current.md. Preserve all prior history, original plan/master/catalog/104-item score definitions and earlier task receipts.

Document the exact GET contract, scope and session boundaries, explicit request lookup, redacted-hash limitation, field meanings, error states, actual commands, evidence paths and source/identity/production gates.

Run actual final promoted-source native/browser acceptance, independently inspect current source/evidence and zero owned processes/listeners/resources, and append only successful actual evidence. A diagnostic pass or unexecuted command cannot close this story.

Final backend gates: pnpm typecheck; pnpm test; pnpm build; pnpm verify:fresh; trusted tools/ralph/automation.test.mjs and tools/ralph/current-status.test.mjs; .venv/bin/python -B ci/security.py. Preserve existing disk/resource/deadline/source-plan-Git guards and intermittent MariaDB failure history.

No root lint script exists; online advisories are separate and must be reported as skipped when offline. Every original P06 target remains open; production_ready=false, training eligibility and enforcement remain false.
